name: Greece
title: Holidays in Greece
intro: Islands, beaches, ruins and long lunches by the sea. Here's where to go on holiday in Greece, and the best time to visit each island.
seo_title: Where to go in Greece: the best places for a holiday

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Greece?
faqs.answer: June and September are best for the islands: warm sea without the peak summer heat and crowds. Crete is also good into October.

faqs.question: Which Greek island is best for a holiday?
faqs.answer: Crete has the most to do, Kefalonia is green and quiet, Naxos is great for food and beaches, and Milos has some of the most unusual coastline in Greece.

faqs.question: How long should a holiday in Greece be?
faqs.answer: A week is enough for one island. Crete is big enough for two weeks.
